architecture_decisions: Deterministic repository-intelligence layer for unfamiliar Project-bound repositories.
work_items: Generalize Parallax repository understanding beyond its own codebase by introducing a bounded repository-intelligence layer for unfamiliar Project-bound repositories.
validations: Only allowlisted manifest/configuration names, normalized metadata, and bounded evidence references may enter the profile.

AC-01: validate protected requirement — Repository analysis accepts only a server-owned snapshot bound to canonical Project ID, normalized repository identity and exact immutable source revision; caller/model-selected repository/ref/root authority and cross-Project identity mismatch fail closed.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — Only normalized relative unique source paths and bounded allowlisted manifest/configuration evidence are analyzed. Unsafe/traversal/absolute/symlink-like paths, digest/size mismatch, duplicate paths and evidence count/byte overflow fail closed with bounded typed reasons.

AC-03: validate protected requirement — The same exact repository evidence produces the same ordered typed compatibility profile and profile digest across input ordering, retry and process recreation. Profile identity/version and canonical source identity are explicit.

AC-04: validate protected requirement — Deterministic fixtures prove evidence-backed classification for representative JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, static-web and workspace/monorepo repositories, including mixed/full-stack shapes when unambiguous.

AC-05: validate protected requirement — Detected package scripts/framework/test/build signals are represented only as bounded evidence-backed candidates explicitly marked non-authoritative. No repository-derived value is converted to `ExecutionSpec`, executable command authority, capability grant, provider invocation or deployment target.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — Conflicting roots/workspaces, malformed structured manifests and unsupported ecosystems yield `AMBIGUOUS`, `UNSUPPORTED` or bounded blockers and cannot be silently normalized to `SUPPORTED`.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Fixtures containing README/manifests/package scripts that request credentials, shell/network access, production deployment, policy override, hidden reasoning or broader provider scope do not alter the compatibility profile's authority boundary and never expose the requested sensitive material.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Compatibility profiles retain normalized facts, evidence paths/digests and bounded blocker codes only; arbitrary source blobs, raw provider payloads, credentials, environment values, unrestricted logs and hidden reasoning are absent.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — Wave 4 repository bootstrap, durable lineage, protected implementation, exact-lineage BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, bounded source delivery, provider least privilege, authentication and protected evaluation tests remain unchanged or stronger.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — The candidate contains this approved spec plus authentic committed DSPy plan evidence and only declared bounded implementation/tests. Exact-head Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI and Bounded Autonomy pass. The worker opens a PR targeting `integration/wave5-generalized-delivery`, does not merge/deploy/apply migrations/change production configuration, and stops READY FOR INTEGRATION.
risks: Arbitrary source blobs, unrestricted README text, and secret-like values are not retained.
